notes.title: New tasks and challenges!
notes.content:
Hello, fans of captivating stories with hidden objects challenges! 
Welcome to the fascinating province of Enchanted Crossroads, a fantasy town filled with thousands of mysterious creatures and hidden artifacts to be discovered. 

  Now you can choose between various task sets for every scene: searching for hidden objects, jigsaw puzzles, spotting the differences, searching by silhouettes! Enjoy your favourite challenges and try something new!

Features:
- NEW jigsaw puzzle games together with classic hidden objects! 
- Build your collection. Go through scenes to try new quests and get more rewards!
- Mystery story with bright characters
- Different hints for you to move at a comfortable pace

Explore the untold chapters of mystical stories and discover new allies in the dynamic universe of “Magic of Runes.” Detective Greystone needs your help in thrilling detective missions!
